name: NotebookLM
desc: Grounded research assistant answering from your own uploaded sources
desc_zh: 基于你自己上传的资料做溯源问答的研究助手
solves: The model invents a citation and you cannot check it. It answers only from documents you uploaded, and every line links back to the source.
solves_zh: 模型编出一个引用，你无从查证。它只依据你上传的文档作答，每一句都能点回原文出处。
best_for: When you are working through a fixed pile of papers and need answers you can verify.
best_for_zh: 当你在啃一批固定的资料，需要能核实的答案时。
